content: Clinical research has demonstrated that reducing A1C levels leads to improved glycemic control and better health outcomes for patients with diabetes. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) provides comprehensive and detailed information about blood glucose fluctuations, enabling individuals to make more informed decisions regarding their dietary intake, physical activity, and medication regimens. CGM has shown particular efficacy for patients undergoing insulin therapy, offering significant advantages in enhancing self-management and optimizing glycemic control in individuals with diabetes.
